verdict: Paid social is profitable and scaling; local discovery and reviews are the untapped growth lever this period.
diagnosis: Muslim Subscription Box campaign drove $10,495 in sales on $1,905 spend this period — roughly $5.50 back per $1.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend near 5.5x
signals.detail: The Muslim Box campaign generated $10,495 in purchases from $1,905 spend this period. Strong efficiency for a cold acquisition push.

signals.headline: 553 purchases at $3.44 average spend
signals.detail: Total purchases this period hit 553 across $1,905 in spend. Cost per purchase is trending down sharply in recent days.

signals.headline: Only 85 checkouts started, 214 carts
signals.detail: Cart-to-checkout drop-off is steep this period. Roughly 60% of add-to-cart users never begin checkout.

signals.headline: 8.18M mobile map impressions, 0 calls
signals.detail: The Google Business profile is being seen locally but driving zero calls or direction requests. Listing is passive.

signals.headline: 272 reviews this period, 0 replies logged
signals.detail: Review volume is healthy but engagement signals suggest owner responses are missing. Local search ranking suffers as a result.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Food and beverage converts higher than most categories
benchmark.body: Food and beverage ecommerce typically converts at 4.5% to 6% versus a 2% to 3% cross-category average. Billy Doe's paid social funnel should be judged against that stronger ceiling.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Online food sales growing 15% year over year
seasonal.body: Overall food sales grew 0.9% last year while online food sales grew 15.1%. Nearly 40% of consumers tried non-traditional food retail like meat subscriptions and on-demand delivery.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: ButcherBox, Crowd Cow, Moink dominate the category
competitor.body: ButcherBox, Crowd Cow, Porter Road, Moink, and Kansas City Steak lead the meat subscription category. Differentiation is shifting toward traceable sourcing, grass-fed, and specialty diets like halal.

recommendations.title: Scale the Muslim Subscription Box campaign budget
recommendations.detail: The most recent day showed a 92x return on ad spend. Consider a measured 20-30% budget lift while creative is fresh, watching frequency (currently 1.2) for fatigue.

recommendations.title: Fix the cart-to-checkout drop-off
recommendations.detail: Test a one-page checkout, guest checkout, and Shop Pay. Only 85 of 214 add-to-carts started checkout this period. Closing that gap could lift purchases meaningfully.

recommendations.title: Activate the Google Business Profile
recommendations.detail: 8.1M map impressions produced zero calls or directions. Worth testing weekly offer posts, a call-to-action button, and replying to all 272 recent reviews to improve local ranking.
